author: smitdalt
body:
Hey guys! 

Postremo is a new Destroy the Monument map made by smitdalt and Mottman2 :D

It is a futuristic themed map featuring large iron supply areas, 4 middle islands for PvP, and 2 monuments for each team! This took a ton of effort over the past few days and its awesome to see the finished product. Anyways, we hope you guys like it! =D

Video of builing the spawn and iron supplies: http://youtu.be/k_qAf4_58AU

YML: http://pastebin.com/s6UAxcMt
Map Download: https://www.mediafire.com/?ifiv8y0a35avzfn
Screenshots:

replies.author: steven5703
replies.body:
Sorry, but after testing this map we have came to the conclusion that it does not fit the server.

Reason:
The map developers played this and some of us decided it wasn't a good fit for the server... it's too classic-ly styled to fit in with the rest of the rotation and some found it confusing. The YAML was also struggling at times and the colors aren't really exciting to play with.

Also, maybe change the monument areas and edit the shape a bit.

https://trello.com/c/ElyyAXHx/29-dtm-postremo
